title: Show It To Me: The First Transaction
label: ch:mw-show-request
canDo: I can point at one thing and ask a shopkeeper, a food seller, or a driver to show it to me, after learning only ख.

payoff.summary: A pointing word and an asking word join one already-taught noun, and the resulting request is then run unchanged over a shopping word, a food word, and a transport word in four separately scored skills.
